title: Hearty Uruguayan Yeast Bao
description: A kid-friendly Uruguayan dish featuring yeasty and fluffy buns, this recipe is perfect for a fun family meal. It is nut-free and made with kombu-cold-extract for added flavor.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, yeast, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the kombu-cold-extract, sugar, egg, and milk.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat the raclette-grill to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Punch down the dough and divide it into 8 equal pieces.
Roll each piece into a ball and flatten it slightly into a disk shape.
Place the buns on the raclette-grill and cook for 12-15 minutes, or until golden brown.
Brush the buns with melted butter and serve hot.
